verdicts.reason: A: the FIZZBANG! logo pill is blown up so big that it competes with the headline. It sits on top of the dark circle and yellow quarter-circle, the white panel runs off the top and right edges, and there is a dead gap between the headline and the CTA. The 'Pop art, / now in a can' line break is at least clean. B: the logo is a bit more restrained but still crashes into the circle and sits close to the left edge. The headline breaks awkwardly into 'Pop art, now in / a can', leaving 'a can' orphaned, and the panel also bleeds off the top with a teal bar poking out below it. A wins narrowly because its headline reads properly.
